post.caption:
The word robot comes from a 1920 play and means forced labour, but self-moving machines are far older. Greek and Chinese water clocks struck bells with mechanical figures, Al-Jazari built devices in the 1200s that could be reset to play different rhythms, which is a programmable machine six centuries before the word, and Vaucanson's 1739 duck appeared to eat and digest. The first industrial arm arrived in 1961 and could not see anything. Motion was never the hard part.
